name: John Gray
bio: Poet. His Silverpoints (Mathews and Lane, 1893) was designed by Ricketts and initially underwritten by Wilde before the two fell out; in the same year The Blackmailers, a play written in collaboration with his close friend Andre Raffalovich, was produced at the Prince of Wales's Theatre. After the publication of The Picture of Dorian Gray he referred to himself as Dorian and allowed others in the Wilde circle to do so, though the editors find no evidence he was the character's original. He became a Roman Catholic, was ordained priest at thirty-five, and spent his later years in Edinburgh, where Raffalovich built St Peter's Church for him; in 1904 he edited and published Last Letters of Aubrey Beardsley, which were written to Raffalovich.
bio_note: All facts from the main-particulars footnote at Holland & Hart-Davis, Complete Letters (2000), p. 520 n. 3 (repo PDF 540, folio confirmed). Born/died 1866-1934 from the same footnote.
